title: Stefan Banach Scholarship Programme
provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) and Ministry of Foreign Affairs
field: Engineering, agriculture, exact and natural sciences, economics
description: Development-cooperation scholarship enabling citizens of selected developing and Eastern Partnership countries to undertake second-cycle (master's) studies in Polish or English at Polish public universities.
amount: Monthly stipend of PLN 1,700 plus exemption from tuition fees

title: Poland My First Choice
provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
description: Scholarship for candidates from countries with a high level of socio-economic development who plan to start full-time second-cycle studies at Polish academic institutions.
amount: Monthly stipend of PLN 1,700 plus a full tuition fee waiver

title: Ignacy Lukasiewicz Scholarship Programme
provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) and Ministry of Education and Science
field: Engineering, agriculture, exact sciences, life sciences
description: Development scholarship for citizens of selected developing countries to undertake full-time second-cycle studies in priority technical and scientific fields at Polish public universities.
amount: Monthly stipend of PLN 1,700 plus a full tuition fee waiver

title: Lane Kirkland Scholarship Programme
provider: Leaders of Change Foundation (with the Polish-American Freedom Foundation)
field: Economics, management, public administration, law, political science, social policy
description: Two-semester non-degree study programme at Polish universities for professionals and academics from Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia who want to contribute to democratic and economic reform in their home countries.
amount: Monthly stipend (around PLN 2,500), accommodation, insurance, travel, study tour and materials

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Poland-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, several coordinated by or including Polish institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
